description: Image Description: The image depicts a vibrant outdoor fruit market stall under a shaded canopy. In the foreground, there are multiple green cardboard boxes neatly arranged in rows, each filled with ripe mangoes of varying shades of green and red, indicating different levels of ripeness. The mangoes are placed in individual compartments within the boxes, which are stacked on wooden pallets for display.
